integrity: The limit is established by a noncommutative product expansion and a triangular-array CLT; the exact finite-step checker is supporting numerical and symbolic evidence, not a substitute for the proof. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional fixed real matrices, equal-probability independent order choices, exact matrix exponentials, and a fixed terminal time; neither unbounded PDE operators nor optimality of splitting methods are treated. Publication precedence requires independent review, especially potential general stochastic-product CLTs. A 1984 general random-product CLT is related but uses a different leading random-increment scale; indirect coverage is a residual originality risk.
title: A sharp Gaussian trajectory-error law for random-order Lie splitting
